feed_title: Tartan Bolster Dog Bed with Waterproof Layer, Leather Carry Handles, Non-Slip Base, Medium to XL | PawLunova Eskdale
descriptionHtml:
Tartan outside. A waterproof layer inside. Handles for the boot.

Eskdale is a tartan bolster dog bed with raised sides, an internal waterproof layer, leather carry handles and a non-slip base, in Medium, Large and XL.

A wet dog does not dry off on the doormat. They come in from the field, go straight to their bed, and turn twice before dropping. By morning the damp has gone somewhere, and on most tartan beds it goes into the filling.

Eskdale puts a waterproof layer between the upholstery and the fill, so rain off a coat or a night-time accident stops there.

What they get

  • A waterproof layer inside: Wet coats and accidents stop before they reach the filling.
  • Leather carry handles: Lift the empty bed to another room or out to the boot.
  • Raised bolster sides: A cushioned edge for a chin or a back.
  • A non-slip base: It holds its place on flagstones and tiles.
  • Tartan upholstery: Heavier under the hand than printed cotton.

Best for: Dogs who come home soaked, houses with hard floors, and anyone whose dog travels.

Why it is worth the money

The Medium is £109 and the XL £139, so here is where that goes. Tartan upholstery with real weight to it. A waterproof layer underneath that costs money and never shows in a photograph, which is why cheaper tartan beds leave it out. Then 100 nights at home to be sure.

One thing to know first. The handles are for the empty bed, not for carrying it with a dog on board, and the leather has its own care rules.

Size and fit

Three sizes, named for the dogs they suit. Medium is cut for a pug, a French bulldog or a dachshund. Large for a cocker spaniel, a cockapoo or a Staffordshire Bull Terrier. XL for a golden retriever, a labrador or a border collie. The bolsters take part of the footprint. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. The leather handles have their own care instructions. Air-dry fully before use.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Measure them on their side, nose to tail base, plus 15 to 20cm. Send their weight and we will confirm.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Your arrival window shows at checkout.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

Where exactly does the waterproof layer sit?

Beneath the tartan and above the fill. The outer fabric can still get wet.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We say what it is, not what it does. Cushioned sides, and a base that will not slide as they push up.

Can I actually wash it?

Follow the sewn-in care label, and the separate one for the leather handles.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Send it back inside 100 nights. Free collection, full refund.

Choose their size and put a waterproof layer under the tartan.
